name: ซันแอนด์มูน GX Starter Deck เฟิร์สอิมแพ็ค

description.text: GX Starter Deck: First Impact, the first Thai-language Pokémon TCG product: a random ready-to-play 60-card deck with one Pokémon-GX, from a pool of more than 140 different cards, 18 of them Pokémon-GX and 24 Trainers, with GX markers, damage counters and a rule book. This set holds every card the decks could contain.
